tasks.title: Shared contracts, participant identity, presence, and scoped storage
checks: Define versioned company, participant, presence, event, thread, artifact, and approval contracts while preserving existing companies.
Test two-seat identity, invite scope, session expiry, company isolation, and private coaching separation.
evidence: Stage 2 SQLite service stores hashed invite/session credentials and expires presence; web/tests/services/stage2-contracts/stage2.test.ts passed; participant-scoped coach memory assertion passed in web/tests/services/ai/learning.test.ts; typecheck and build passed.

tasks.title: Company setup choices and LAN invite flow
checks: Exercise Single/Collaborative, Practice/Real world, Startup/Mature, and bank/restaurant/semiconductor/existing presets without changing the five roles.
Join by invite in two isolated browser contexts; refuse a third participant and show an actionable invalid/full-link state. The physical-device gate is S2-10.
evidence: Production Playwright passed invite join, two names, and two-seat presence in isolated contexts; fixture HTTP smoke through the LAN address refused a third join and invalid credentials. The physical-device gate remains S2-10.

tasks.title: Company-scoped shared conversation and private chat boundary
checks: Deliver author-labeled student and AI messages once to both clients; retain thread, status, and artifact references.
Prove one company's thread and each student's private coach history cannot be read through another session.
evidence: Production Playwright delivered an author-labeled PRD to both browser contexts; company-scoped artifact and private participant memory tests passed.

tasks.title: Student support PRD to engineering feature workflow
checks: Trace issue to student-authored support brief, engineering clarification, student-authored implementation, actual checks, and review in two browser contexts; physical devices are S2-10.
Switch student roles without changing message authorship or losing work.
evidence: Production Playwright traced support PRD, engineer clarification, support reply, failed and passing checked code attempts, review, and attributed thread artifacts in two isolated browser contexts.

tasks.title: Bounded AI coworker handoffs and approval gateway
checks: Test role allowlists, company/task scope, untrusted-content handling, provider fallback, limits, and append-only attribution.
With approval On, prove Reject blocks delivery and Approve releases exactly one internal handoff; no model message self-approves.
evidence: Fixture smoke passed all five role drafts, twelve-message cap, cross-origin rejection, approval Reject and exactly-once Approve; live rehearsal returned Meta for supervisor, engineering handoff, and Pause task. Policy prompt forbids external action and treats thread text as untrusted.

tasks.title: Company and stage-specific foreground event engine
checks: Compare bank, restaurant, and semiconductor events at Startup and Mature stages; assert roughly five-second shared cadence and no model call on event ticks.
Test concurrent polls, idempotent event IDs, bounded retained history, and simulated coworker action/outcome logs with accurate provenance.
evidence: Unit tests passed industry/stage variation, all five role seeds per preset, five-second cadence, and 120-event retention; fixture HTTP smoke passed two simultaneous polls with one shared event ID. Event ticks contain no model call.

tasks.title: Shared Pause, presence expiry, and temporary run cleanup
checks: Two clients observe one Pause/Resume state, including concurrent requests and reconnects.
After the last participant expires, verify no further events and deletion of temporary run/feed while company and Practice progress survive.
evidence: Production Playwright passed shared Pause and Resume; fixture smoke proved exclusive claim and deleted run/feed after both Leave requests plus expiry grace while messages persisted; unit tests covered paused tick suppression and expired sessions.

tasks.title: Responsive engineering issue and editor split
checks: Inspect desktop left issue/right code layout and narrow stacked layout with keyboard and reduced-motion checks.
Run existing isolated code checks, Submit, feedback, and revision with a workplace feature task.
evidence: Production Playwright verified desktop issue-left/editor-right, 390-pixel stacked layout with no overflow, isolated checks, failed attempt, passing revision, and feedback. Existing keyboard/reduced-motion office paths remained in the regression suite.

tasks.title: Contextual pause task and activity/conversation surfaces
checks: Pause on a company event, open a role-specific task, submit and receive the relevant real feedback, then resume the shared feed.
Inspect author/provenance labels, accessible announcements, no focus stealing, loading/retry/fallback states, and both participants' views.
evidence: Production Playwright passed contextual Pause task, revision and Resume in both browser contexts; labels separate simulated outcomes, student work, and AI fixtures. Native artifact dialog supports Escape; new messages announce politely and follow the latest entry without stealing focus.

tasks.title: Two-device integration and single-student regression gate
checks: Rehearse a mature bank support-to-engineering handoff and shared Pause/Resume on two LAN devices; compare startup restaurant and mature semiconductor variants.
Verify third-join refusal, approval Reject/Approve, company/privacy isolation, expiry cleanup, provider failure recovery, and baseline single-student learning/voice/retrieval/meeting/coding/review.
Run lint, typecheck, focused tests, optimized build, production browser flows, and capture representative screenshots.
evidence: Full production Playwright suite passed 5 scenarios with 3 project-inapplicable skips; lint, typecheck, 36 unit tests, optimized build, fixture and live Meta smokes, service checks, both harness checkers, and screenshots passed. On October 25, the physical phone joined a mature-bank Real world company over its hotspot as Daniel. The host observed the support PRD, Daniel's engineering clarification, a shared Pause holding the event count at 48, and Resume advancing it to 49 and 50. The campus Wi-Fi attempt failed before the join form; the successful hotspot test used a four-minute firewall exception limited to the phone IP and TCP port 3000. Bedrock Sonnet remains separately unverified pending a local key.
